bootstrap.blocking: cohort, one index per cohort shared by every build that scores it
bootstrap.context_draw: drawn with the resample, jointly across models and builds
bootstrap.per_build_rows: under the 'all' and 'nearest' poolings, in the rows whose scope is a build; the arm's rows carry scope 'arm'
bootstrap.per_draw: the 'all' pooling repeated with each context draw held fixed, in the rows whose draw is set
bootstrap.multiplicity: none: every interval is reported at alpha on its own

statistics.gini, abs_log_oe, cox_slope_deviation, p: the mean over the cells in scope, paired by cell; a build with more cohorts contributes more cells
statistics.auc_slope: least-squares slope of the cell's AUC on its age in quarters with one intercept per build, over the cells in scope; at the arm's scope the within-build movements are pooled with each build weighted by the spread of its ages, at a build's scope it is that build's own slope
statistics.difference: later model minus earlier in the order scorecard, gbm, gbm-50k, tabpfn, tabicl, then the tagged settings

psi.reference: the build's training rows for a fitted model, the context draw for a seeded one
